findings.title: Null output breaks not-found error message
findings.problem: When npm exits non-zero (or returns nothing) with no output, $output is $null; @($output) yields one null element and $_.ToString() throws a null-method error under ErrorActionPreference=Stop, so the intended 'was not found in registry' message is never built. Unmet acceptance criterion 3.
findings.impact: Users get an opaque PowerShell error instead of the actionable registry guidance; required criterion 3 is partial. Reachability confirmed: line 99 condition routes empty output here.
findings.check_notes: install.ps1:100 filters null elements before ToString(); null-method error no longer possible.

fix.change: Filter null entries from $output before ToString() when building the npm output text in Get-PackageVersion
